FCI BREEDS WITH VARIETIES AND CACIB AWARD *

Please find HEREUNDER a list of the FCI definitively recognized breeds (according to original breed name) with varieties (size/coat/colour) and the corresponding CACIB distribution (*).

We draw your attention to the fact that the breeds that are NOT recognised by the FCI and the breeds that are recognised by the FCI on a PROVISIONAL basis are NOT eligible for the CACIB.

CACIB: * Certificat d'Aptitude au Championnat International de Beauté (award for the title “International Beauty Champion”)
Working trial: *
(*)
(**) 		subject to a working trial according to the FCI Breeds Nomenclature
subject to a working trial only for the countries having applied for it
subject to a working trial only for the Nordic countries (Finland, Norway, Sweden)
